perturbation_parameters_note: Dataset-specific valid-perturbation parameters: sigma=0.005 of TRAIN range for numeric variables and p_change=0.05 for binary/categorical/ordinal variables.
continuous: Gaussian local noise with SD=sigma*train_range; clip to train min/max.
discrete_numeric: Gaussian local noise with SD=sigma*train_range; project to nearest train-observed valid value.
binary: Keep valid states; switch with p_change to another train-observed state.
categorical: Switch with p_change; sample only train-observed categories according to empirical train distribution.
ordinal: Switch with p_change; remain within train-observed valid ordinal values.
transform_after_perturbation: same fitted feature selection + same fitted encoder + same fitted MinMaxScaler; no refit

metrics.Stability_S: Mean squared L2 distance between normalized sparse base SHAP-LCD explanation and perturbed explanations; lower is more stable.
metrics.Consistency_C_imp: Mean truth value of implication (cosine_similarity >= tau) => prediction_preserved.
metrics.PredKeep_imp: Fraction whose predicted class equals base predicted class.
